name: stage1_start_dso3x2
title: Stage-I analytic design point (contraction screen + tap engagement), doubled-DSO_3 network
description: NOT a tuned point: this is the starting point for a Stage-II search.
Gauge g_v is pinned so the supervisory voltage priority pi = g*sigma^2 equals 1.
Continuous scale placed by bisection against the layer contraction targets; tap weights priced from the stated engagement deviations.

The per-DSO scenario multipliers are NOT part of this parameter set -- they are network, not weights -- but the curvature this point was designed against was captured on the network recorded under provenance.network. Screening these weights on a different network does not reproduce the reported lambda_max(B).
